title: [v0.4.29] Architecture: define the host interface and guard
author: mcpdev80
body:
Parent: #818

## Goal

Inventory every real host-dependent call site and define the smallest Host Platform Contract that isolates platform mechanics from BaseHarbor domain/lifecycle semantics.

This child owns the **contract and seam**, not platform-specific feature completion.

## Current-code findings

Confirmed host assumptions include:

- `internal/hostresource/memory.go`: Linux `/proc/meminfo` + PSI.
- `cmd/baha/app_memory_preflight.go`: Linux-specific remediation text.
- `cmd/baha/app_backup_restore_guided.go`: `/proc/self/fd/<fd>` secret-file handoff.
- `internal/hosttrust/hosttrust.go`: automatic trust installation only on Linux.
- `internal/operatorauth/login.go`: direct GOOS browser-open branching.
- `internal/health/doctor.go`: host OS and runtime executable discovery.
- `cmd/baha/update.go`: self-update restricted to Linux amd64/arm64.
- state/path code in runtime/deployment/orgconfig uses XDG/home conventions that need platform classification.
- Podman Quadlet implementation directly depends on `systemctl --user`; keep that runtime-specific rather than generalizing it into the host contract.

## Required work

1. Classify each call site as:
   - generic host-platform semantic;
   - Runtime Provider implementation detail;
   - Target Access concern;
   - local presentation/client concern;
   - safe portable stdlib behavior that needs no abstraction.

2. Define the minimum internal contract around only demonstrated needs.

3. Add deterministic fake implementations for tests.

4. Add an architecture guard so new direct platform branching/calls do not leak into disallowed packages.

5. Define typed capability/unsupported results with cause/remediation/next action.

## Candidate contract semantics

Evaluate, do not blindly copy:

```text
PlatformIdentity
HostResourceObservations (host-only evidence input)
TrustStore
Filesystem
SecureEphemeralMaterial
BrowserOpen
TerminalCapabilities
ServiceCapabilities
RuntimeEnvironmentHints
```

Avoid one giant interface if focused subinterfaces make dependencies clearer.

## Hard rules

- no new Application Intent fields;
- no host OS names in portable runtime/capability contracts;
- no generic plugin framework;
- no duplication of Runtime Provider responsibilities;
- platform-specific adapters may use GOOS/build tags internally, callers may not depend on them;
- unsupported is a first-class typed result, not an arbitrary string.

## Tests

- fake-platform conformance;
- architecture guard;
- unsupported-capability diagnostics;
- no-dead-end remediation tests;
- exact current Linux semantics captured before refactor.

## Acceptance

- [ ] inventory committed/documented;
- [ ] every inventoried call site classified;
- [ ] minimum contract implemented;
- [ ] fake platform test implementation exists;
- [ ] architecture guard prevents new leakage;
- [ ] no runtime/provider semantics were pulled into the host contract;
- [ ] child Linux/Windows/macOS implementations can conform without changing portable semantics.


---

## Release assignment (2026-10-10)
This platform item now belongs to **v0.4.29 #876**, not the old v0.4.25 plan. Two sessions: Host/Linux/WSL2 (#819–#821) and Darwin/macOS + qualification (#822–#823); final audit #817. Host contract semantics must be pinned in v0.4.25 #872 and consumed here without silent redefinition; final release-wide acceptance #174 is v0.4.31. Real runtime evidence required.

---

## macOS supplement (2026-10-14)

See #876 for the authoritative consolidated scope and decisions D1–D5.

### Additional inventory (missing from the list above)

| Call site | Host assumption | Proposed classification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd/baha/app_backup_restore_guided.go` | untagged `unix.MemfdCreate`, `TCGETS/TCSETS` → **darwin does not compile** | secure ephemeral material + terminal; fixed ahead in #882 |
| `cmd/baha/tui_host_resources.go` | reads `/proc/meminfo`, `/proc/loadavg`, `/proc/pressure/memory` directly | presentation consumer of capacity evidence (D2) |
| `cmd/baha/human_open.go` | second GOOS browser-open switch (duplicate of `operatorauth/login.go`) | browser handoff; consolidate |
| `cmd/baha/control_plane_operations.go:148`, `internal/health/doctor.go:28` | report darwin/windows as `os` OK | identity/support level; must not be a false green |
| `internal/runtime/terminal/process_other.go`, `internal/runtimeexplorer/terminal.go:59` | PTY "Linux only", `GOOS == "linux"` gate | terminal capability |
| `internal/runtime/docker_engine.go:51` | default `rootless`; Docker Desktop observed as `rootful` | runtime engine observation (D1) |
| `internal/providers/runtime/podman/provider.go:51` | no host Quadlet → `ErrRuntimeNotFound` | Runtime Provider detail; #883 |
| `internal/application/workload_security.go:308` | socket deny-list knows only Linux socket paths | runtime engine observation (engine-reported socket) |
| `internal/operatorauth/config.go:110` | sessions under `os.UserCacheDir()` (`~/Library/Caches` on macOS) while other state uses XDG-style `~/.local/share` | filesystem/path policy |
| `cmd/baha/node.go:731` | `systemctl --user` for node install | Target/Node concern; typed unsupported off Linux |
| `.goreleaser.yaml`, `scripts/install.sh:27`, `release.yml:530` | linux-only artifacts, installer and attestation | distribution; #822 |
| `internal/devgateway/gateway.go:504`, `render.go:63` | listen/publish on `127.0.0.1` only, while macOS resolves `*.localhost` to `::1` first (observed) | host networking; verify the browser/curl path, not just the internal pinned dial |

### Contract review items (escalation per #876; resolve before dependent implementation)

- **D1 — engine isolation:** apply the authoritative classification and provenance rules in #876. Preserve observed privilege and execution-location facts; VM isolation is not automatic rootless equivalence. Review the pinned spec before adding `vm-isolated`. Context/socket names are discovery hints, not proof of VM identity, ownership or safe host file sharing.
- **D2 — effective runtime capacity:** apply #876. Host adapters may supply host observations; the runtime/engine observer supplies selected runtime/VM evidence. Admission consumes one resolved evidence model with source, timestamp, effective limits and measured/estimated/unknown quality. Physical RAM, `MemTotal`, `MemFree`, or total minus container stats alone must not establish SAFE. Exact collectors remain implementation details.

### Added acceptance

- [ ] Additional inventory rows classified.
- [ ] D1 and D2 recorded in the pinned spec with review sign-off before #820/#822/#883 depend on them.
- [ ] Architecture guard also covers direct `/proc` reads in `cmd/baha` presentation code and duplicate browser-open switches.

- [ ] D1 rejects spoofed context names, mismatched endpoint/machine owners, unknown VM provenance and implicit rootful-host fallback.
- [ ] D2 distinguishes total/free/available/estimated memory and never promotes incomplete or stale runtime capacity to SAFE.
